title: Sales today
description: Net sales invoiced today against yesterday.

title: Sales this month
description: Net sales since the 1st of this month against the same days last month.

title: Sales this year
description: Net sales since the start of the year against the same period last year.

title: Orders this month
description: Number of sales orders since the 1st of this month.

title: Month-on-month sales
description: Net sales for each of the last 12 months.

title: Day sales
description: Net sales for each day of this month, with last month behind it.

title: Recent high-value sales
description: The latest sales orders above the high-value limit.

title: Top customers
description: Customers ranked by net sales this month.

title: Top materials
description: Materials ranked by net sales this month.

title: Month target
description: Net sales this month against the monthly sales target.

title: Invoice status split
description: Share of orders that are paid, open or overdue.

title: Receivables outstanding
description: Invoice amount not yet collected.

title: Collections this month
description: Payments received since the 1st of this month.

title: Collections against target
description: Payments received this month against the collection target.

title: Receivables ageing
description: Outstanding invoices grouped by how long they are overdue.

title: Cash in and out
description: Cash received against cash paid out for each month.

title: Most overdue accounts
description: Accounts with the highest overdue balance.

title: Recent payments
description: The latest incoming payments and the invoice they cleared.

title: Expenses by category
description: How operating expenses are shared between categories.

title: Purchases this month
description: Purchase order value raised since the 1st of this month.

title: Open purchase orders
description: Purchase orders not yet fully received.

title: Purchase spend trend
description: Purchase order value for each of the last six months.

title: Top vendors
description: Vendors ranked by purchase value this month.

title: Spend by category
description: How purchase value is shared between material groups.

title: On-time delivery
description: Share of purchase order lines delivered by the promised date.

title: Recent purchase orders
description: The latest purchase orders and where they stand.

title: Spend by category per month
description: Purchase value each month split by material group.

title: Stock value
description: Value of all stock on hand across warehouses.

title: Items below reorder level
description: Materials whose stock has fallen below the reorder level.

title: Stock availability
description: Share of materials currently in stock against the availability target.

title: Stock by warehouse
description: Stock value held in each warehouse.

title: Stock by material group
description: How stock value is shared between material groups.

title: Slow-moving materials
description: Materials that have not moved for the longest time.

title: Receipts and issues
description: Goods received against goods issued for each month.

title: Reorder list
description: Materials to reorder soon with their current stock.

title: Goods movement by weekday and hour
description: When goods are received and issued through the week.

title: Shipments this month
description: Export shipments dispatched since the 1st of this month.

title: Export revenue
description: Invoiced export value this month.

title: Export revenue trend
description: Invoiced export value for each of the last six months.

title: Top destinations
description: Destination countries ranked by export value.

title: Shipments by mode
description: How shipments are shared between sea, air and road.

title: Shipments in transit
description: Export shipments on their way and when they are due.

title: Shipments per day
description: A year calendar showing which days shipments went out.

title: Units produced today
description: Finished units reported from the shop floor today.

title: Equipment effectiveness
description: Overall equipment effectiveness against the target.

title: Output against plan
description: Units produced for each month against the production plan.

title: Downtime by cause
description: Hours of machine stoppage grouped by cause.

title: Scrap by reason
description: How scrapped units are shared between reasons.

title: Output by line and shift
description: Units produced on each line in each shift.

title: Open production orders
description: Production orders still running and how far along they are.
